title: Why Wealth Taxes Always Fail
gist: With an EU-wide supranational wealth tax, a California billionaire tax, and similar proposals floated in New York, France, and Denmark, the author argues the historical record is unambiguous: where wealth taxes have been tried they have usually been abandoned, and for good reason.

insights.claim: Wealth-tax proposals are live simultaneously in the EU (a supranational wealth tax), California (a billionaire tax), New York, France, and Denmark, reflecting a growing conviction that extreme wealth concentration warrants extraordinary responses.
insights.speaker: CRISTINA ENACHE
insights.so_what: A cluster of concurrent jurisdictions raises the probability that at least one enacts — relevant to domicile planning, HNW asset location, and private-bank flows out of affected states.
insights.quote: Proposals for a supranational wealth tax in the European Union, a billionaire tax in California, and the floating of similar measures in New York, France, and Denmark
insights.locator: MADRID—Around the world, wealth taxes have become a major topic

insights.claim: Where wealth taxes have been tried, they have usually been abandoned — and the author argues this repeated abandonment happened for good, predictable reasons rather than political accident.
insights.speaker: CRISTINA ENACHE
insights.so_what: Base rates favor repeal or sharp dilution of any enacted wealth tax; positioning for permanent regime change in wealth taxation is likely premature.
insights.quote: where wealth taxes have been tried, they have usually been abandoned—and for good reason
insights.locator: A clear-eyed view of past experience

insights.claim: Policymakers in California, New York, and France are treated as revisiting an 'old idea' rather than innovating, implying the failure modes are already documented and foreseeable.
insights.speaker: CRISTINA ENACHE
insights.so_what: Use prior wealth-tax episodes (valuation disputes, capital flight, weak yield) as the template for forecasting outcomes of the current proposals.
insights.quote: they should heed the lessons of this history
insights.locator: As policymakers in California, New York, France
